cut_semantics.removed_corner: x < -0.321 AND z > 0; the native helper flips the second axis
cut_semantics.named_view_limitation: Native named views apply hidden, cut_on and state, but do not apply per-view cut_at/axes/sections. All cut views use the same global cut.

preview_review.scope: Recovery filename scan for colon/gut/teaching .png/.jpg/.jpeg and source/evidence catalog review. Matches were histology/radiology images, not attributable model previews. No image viewed; no rendering performed.

native_application_path: Lead writes these native properties into a new output overlay app/micro/teaching_defaults.json under colon_wall, preserving the original inputs.
Existing apply_teaching_defaults applies fields to the registered MicroModel after registration.
Existing ProceduralModel copies viewer_cameras and start_view; exact item keys equal part names.
Existing ModelViewport.reset_view chooses start_view and set_named_view sets the hidden list, cut_on and assembled state.
The later normal-selector integration must use the candidate defaults together with candidate source/cache and verify all controls. Sidecar existence alone is not installation evidence.
limitations: Camera targets and widths are source-derived candidate framing only. No native screenshot, generation, numerical mesh acceptance or visual approval obtained.
Labels, native manual hiding/isolation and frame selection remain ordinary existing controls; this sidecar does not change label behavior.
Views deliberately use assembled state and no separation because function cannot be inferred from exploded geometry.
No dynamic flows or unsupported native opacity controls are introduced.
